title: scorecard template variables
description: Values for templates/scorecard.md.j2 and templates/scorecard.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from scorecard.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

candidate_name.description: The candidate's name as they wrote it. Declared sensitive so it never leaves your machine - this is an evaluative record about an identified person and the assembler has no business holding it.

competency_source.title: Competency source
competency_source.description: Path to the interview design doc holding the competency list and weights. If the weights are not written down somewhere both interviewers read, the weighted score below is decoration.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date of the interview, ISO. Evidence decays: a scorecard read the same week is context, the same card read six months later is a rumour with a number attached.

interviewer_name.title: Interviewer name
interviewer_name.description: Who ran this round and is accountable for the evidence in it. One name - a card filled in by a panel averages away the disagreement, which was the useful part.

role_title.title: Role title
role_title.description: The role exactly as advertised, not the internal level code. The competencies scored below must be the ones in that advert, or this scorecard measures a different job than the one applied for.

round_label.title: Round label
round_label.description: Which round this is and what it covered - "Round 2, systems design". Scores only combine across rounds if each round says what it was measuring.
